tq.quote: E-assist	Shimano STEPS EP6 Cargo	UL 2849 certified
Xtracycle equipped the Swoop ASM with a Shimano STEPS EP6 Cargo drive unit. It outputs 250W (~500W max) and 85Nm of torque, reaching 28MPH.

wh.quote: Battery	Shimano STEPS BT-EN606-A	630Wh (frame, external), up to 60mi per charge (depending on riding conditions), UL 2271 certified ⟶ E-assist class	Class 3
The 630Wh Shimano battery is rated for up to 60 miles (96 km) of range
Speaking of the battery, it’s a 630 Wh unit which has quite a bit more life than the 500 Wh battery on most bikes we’ve tested.

range.quote: Battery	Shimano STEPS BT-EN606-A	630Wh (frame, external), up to 60mi per charge (depending on riding conditions), UL 2271 certified ⟶ E-assist class	Class 3
Although this will be dependent on power level, terrain, and rider and cargo weight, we seemed to get about 50 miles of range.
